prompt: Hi there, my name is Rindre and I love playing RPG games and I'm making my own. I like to voice act. and I want to lend my voice to a game project. If you are interested in working with me, please don't hesitate to contact me via email: rinderedere@gmail.com My only rule is to always credit me. I prefer if you link to my game development blog (http://pakilusin.co.vu/) as Rindre Rindere, or link back to my Freesound account Montblanccandies.
